watches.name: TIME MASTER 70 GINGER ALE
watches.description: With its warm champagne dial and polished silver hands, the Time Master 70 Ginger Ale is inspired by the relaxed optimism of the 1970s and the refreshing feeling of long summer days. Powered by the Miyota 9039 automatic movement and protected by a sapphire crystal, the Time Master 70 combines vintage character with modern reliability. Designed to be worn every day and appreciated for years to come, Ginger Ale is a distinctive timepiece that proves subtle can be just as memorable.

watches.name: PARAMOUNT PISTACHIO
watches.description: Fresh yet sophisticated, the Paramount Pistachio offers a distinctive take on vintage dress watch design. Inspired by the softer color palettes of a bygone era, it brings character and individuality to an otherwise timeless silhouette. Swiss Made and powered by the renowned Sellita SW210 hand-wound movement, the Paramount combines traditional watchmaking with modern reliability. Designed for those who appreciate understated elegance and enduring style, it is equally at home beneath a dress cuff or paired with a more relaxed wardrobe.

watches.name: RACE MASTER CHRONOGRAPH AZUL
watches.description: Inspired by the iconic racing liveries that defined endurance motorsport in the late 1960s and early 1970s, the Race Master Azul captures the optimism, speed, and unmistakable character of a golden era in racing. The combination of blue and orange evokes memories of legendary machines crossing the finish line, making every glance at the wrist feel like a tribute to motorsport history. Powered by the Seiko VK64 meca-quartz chronograph movement and protected by a double domed sapphire crystal, the Race Master combines vintage racing character with modern reliability. Designed for enthusiasts who appreciate the romance of classic motorsport, it delivers the look and feel of a vintage chronograph with the practicality required for everyday wear.
